# Gender Expression

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GenderExpression`](gmeow-GenderExpression.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GenderExpression>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gender`](../../slices/gender.md)

A person's SELF-ASSERTED gender expression — how they present (a [`gmeow:GenderExpressionStyle`](gmeow-GenderExpressionStyle.md) value via [`gmeow:expressionValue`](../properties/gmeow-expressionValue.md)). A distinct axis from gender identity: expression is never inferred from identity (or vice versa), nor from sex or address.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](gmeow-IdentityFacet.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:GenderExpression`](gmeow-GenderExpression.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](gmeow-IdentityFacet.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
